title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My dear friends!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are currently ranked third in the Phoenix Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For a group with so few members performing on such a small stage, this is not a bad result. However! We must aim higher!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to put on a show so incredible, it will blow the audience away and send us to the top. Then we'll be featured in a TV commercial... And from there, earn world fame!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Moving on...
Can we actually discuss our next show now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guh... Not listening to me as usual...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? You look lost in thought, Emu.
What's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, er... I was just wondering what our next show should be like!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's it going to be? I'd like a razzle-dazzle show that makes everyone go WOW!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's my thinking exactly.
A gripping and glamorous show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, we don't have the time to be toying with vague concepts like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're right behind the group in second, but there's a huge gap between us and the top group from the Phoenix Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really? Yikes...! You're right!
It's almost double what we got!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our last show earned us some notoriety, but that's still a huge gap to close if we're going to aim for the top.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely. Which is why jabbering about razzle-dazzle or the wow factor won't do us much good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to seriously raise the bar and come up with something so exceptional that the audience will go wild!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's come up with some concrete ideas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not easy to come up with something on the spot, you know...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if you're all drawing a blank, we might be able to move things along...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Don't tell me you've already got something, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nice, you never fail to rise to the circumstances!
That's my esteemed director! So, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tis the season so...
A Christmas show seems like a no-brainer.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Tsukasa
rows.Line: A Christmas show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's it! I love it! We can have lots of singing and dancing in it too, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aaand! One of us could dress up as Santa and give presents to the audience! How about that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Presents? Of course...! We can attach little notes that even say, Please vote for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's bribery.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-right...! I'm ashamed of letting such a thought creep into my mind...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... You don't need to make a big deal about it every time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A Christmas-themed show should draw in a large audience at this time of year, but what sort of performance were you thinking of exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tis season to be jolly, and what better way to express that than by singing? Hence, a musical.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A musical?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And how does everyone feel about A Merry Christmas for the title?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sounds okay, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and the plot goes something like this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We have a lonely girl living in an orphanage somewhere, but has never been visited by Santa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She isn't expecting to see him this Christmas either, but...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A young boy, Santa's apprentice, appears at her window.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alas, he's lost his reindeers, and with them, all the presents he was entrusted with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The girl decides to help him out, and so begins their Christmas adventure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's what I have so far.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! It has a razzle-dazzle factor and makes you go WOW♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But wait a minute... The main protagonist of this story is that orphan girl, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ARE YOU GOING TO HAVE ME BE A LITTLE GIRL?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did you even arrive at that conclusion...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have two protagonists, the girl and Santa's apprentice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was thinking of having Tsukasa play as the apprentice and Nene as the girl.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What, me...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why not Emu? She's probably much better for this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show will reach its climax during the scene where the girl sings.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've been starring in musicals since you were little, so I thought you'd be the perfect fit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But me as the heroine...
I'm not sure if I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is great, Nene! We'll get to hear your amazing singing♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, I haven't agreed to anything yet...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You don't want to?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I really want to hear you sing♪
I love your singing voice sooo much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Besides, we might both be leads, but I am the one that's going to steal the spotlight in the end!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: By jumping around and being obnoxious?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Hey, that's rude! Don't get so cocky just because you have a singing role!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. How about it, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll do great, and the others seem to share my opinion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If it's a musical, it should be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. I'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Rui, what do I get to be?
Can I be a reindeer?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For you I have the role of a child eagerly awaiting her Christmas presents. I'll be playing a minor role as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Once I'm done testing Robo-Nene, it should be ready to perform in the show as well. We're all going to be in it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right! Let's get to work on this!
We're going to make it to the top this time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do this! Wonderhoy!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm, I wouldn't have guessed this is how the play would end. I think it's good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's a great story. True to the Christmas spirit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm pleased to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sort of starting to look forward to it. It's been such a long time since I was in a musical.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: G-GUYS...!! You won't believe this...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What happened, Emu? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I went to see what the Phoenix Stage group is doing for the next round and... It's a Christmas musical too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They have the highest score so far, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! What a coincidence, huh?
I was super surprised!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But isn't it cool that we get to see a Christmas show done by someone else too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, this is terrible news for us!
The same exact theme...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be in direct competition for the same crowd! This is bad... Can we go with something else, or is it too late?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I figured that this might happen, given that it's so close to Christmas, so I don't think it's a problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Making sudden changes to our play just because someone else is doing something similar wouldn't be good either, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't argue with that... If we are to win, we should do so by standing up to our rivals.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On the other hand, leaving this situation to unfold as it may also seems dangerous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then what do you propose?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A secret investigation of the Phoenix Stage!
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sneaky sneaky...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sneak sneak sneak....
Captain, I've successfully infiltrated the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What a jolly little spying mission...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, keep it down...!
We're trying to keep a low profile!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Look who's talking. Keep YOUR voice down or someone will notice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew this stage was better than ours, but I wasn't expecting this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is the biggest stage in the park! Its troupe has the most actors and the hall can fit more people than anywhere else.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it had some renovations done recently, so it looks a little different than it used to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph! I don't like this... These guys are getting more votes than anyone else probably because they get to use this gorgeous building!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you know what?! A real star doesn't need a fancy... I mean, a gaudy stage like this to shine! They're going to learn this the hard way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What did I say about keeping your voice down?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Look, they're starting a rehearsal.
Their cast is far bigger than in ours...
Is everyone ready? We're starting with the opening number.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! They're gonna sing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wonder what their songs are like...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her voice is... Incredible...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only is her technique better than mine, her voice really resonates.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(It's not like she's just good at singing...
She's completely immersed in her role too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! She's sparkling up there...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, now... I didn't suspect that they had a singer of her caliber. She must be their prima donna.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... I hate to admit it, but she's good...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She was amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I can't do what she just did...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, that was pretty good...
As it is, this is going to be tough for us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Probably...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's get back to our stage and talk strategy...
I thought I saw someone spying on us. Have you come to check us out, Wonderlands×Showtime? Did you like what you saw?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're that girl from before...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the singing Phoenix Stage girl!
Hm? Don't tell me you don't even know my name?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?
I'm Sakurako Seiryuin, the prima donna of the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Which obviously means I am the best performer in all of Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: How can you call yourselves theater people and not recognize me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You think very highly of yourself...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! She's just like you, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize for this intrusion, but we were simply curious about what you, the top group, were working on this time.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Ah... You must be Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I find it a pleasant surprise that you know me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But of course. I make a habit of seeing all the shows in the park. I've seen a few of yours as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You've seen our shows?! Yay! I'm so happy!
How were they? Did you like them?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The direction was good. What always seems randomly thrown together at first turns out to be all carefully tied together in the end like a real show.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But that's where it stops...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The acting was dynamic but without finesse. It's very amateurish and can't compare to us!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I also was told that you also plan to do a Christmas musical?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
With you as the lead... Kusanagi was it?
She has some talent for singing but...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm sure you can see that we're in a totally different league! One or two good songs would still leave your chances of winning at zero!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't sing the way she does...
She puts everything into every note.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I can't match that... )

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Just make it so that your show doesn't bring any shame to the park. Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You... You...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You snooty brat!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: W-What did you just call me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our stage may look like something that could get blown away by a strong breeze, but our shows are the crème de la crème!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you're wrong if you think Nene can't sing as well as you!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Oh my. With such a hothead for a leader, it's no wonder your shows are the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You just keep playing pretend while you let the real stars shine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: T-That's enough...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa may be an idiot, but you have no right calling our shows pretend or anything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're not going to lose... N-Not to someone like you...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Hmph....
We'll see about that in the next round.

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Ms. Seiryuin! The break is almost over!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Excuse me, Wonder Stage crew. You seem like all bark and no bite, but prove me wrong IF you can!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now we know what to do...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our mission, as Wonderlands×Showtime, is to crush the Phoenix Stage troupe!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Slow down, Tsukasa. Let's not change our priorities on a whim.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our goal is, and has always been, to produce shows which will delight our audience. We must not forget that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, listen to Rui! It's not good to get so tied up in knots!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
M-My bad...
I need to cool off...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, you should do that.
And that applies to you too, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to get so flustered, Nene, considering how shy you are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She was making fun of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, that is true...
That was quite unforgivable.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the only way we should get revenge is by putting on an amazing show that knocks her socks off!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For show! Something really super amazing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Was that supposed to be, for sure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, for show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. You're proud of coming up with that, huh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, let's forget about that unpleasant encounter, clear our heads and get back to rehearsing!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How was that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was good. You conveyed the girl's loneliness very well with your voice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It made me feel so sorry for her! I think I started to tear up...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm nowhere near as good as her...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All that's left is the final song, so shall we try it out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The girl bursts into song as her emotions well up while watching Santa's young apprentice disappear into the snowy night.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is the climax of the play.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Got it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww...! That's so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can do it, and I'm not losing control of my voice like last time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her voice was stronger, richer...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I just can't sing like her...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, everybody! That's it for today.
Let's pack up and go home!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, what's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You seemed a bit down, so I thought something was wrong...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I keep thinking that my singing isn't as good as that other girl's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The girl from earlier? You mean Sakurako Seiryuin?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She certainly is an excellent singer and can stir her audience's emotions with the power of her voice alone...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I believe you're in the same league as her, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Same! That puffed-up girl isn't any better at singing than you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe that's how it seems to you all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Seiryuin's singing is... Just so different. I can tell because I've spent so much time learning about songs from musicals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know how to put it into words, but she has a way of breathing life into each note. I don't know how I can...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry. Go ahead without me. I'll stay back and practice some more.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I feel that it's my responsibility, as the stage director, to help Nene overcome her insecurity.)
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... In the end, my singing was nothing special.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it even possible for me to ever sing like her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A musical with mediocre singing will only flop.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which means we won't win the contest, and it'll all be my fault.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My fault, again...)

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member
rows.Line: Kusanagi came to practice? You'd think she wouldn't show her face again after what happened last time.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member
rows.Line: I mean, she never really talks to anyone else, so what did she expect?

rows.Speaker: Troupe Member
rows.Line: We put so much effort into this and she ruined it for the rest of us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No... I can't let that happen again...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to practice more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to learn to sing better than her and make our show a success...!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That wasn't any good either. I need to modulate my voice better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, how much longer do you plan on singing? We have other scenes to rehearse, you know.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Did you even hear what I just said?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui, I'm worried about Nene.
She's been practicing that song all morning...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, would you mind coming over here for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it? I'm busy now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I may have an idea regarding what's missing in your songs.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You do?
What is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Before I tell you, would you mind singing once more? I need to make sure my suspicions are correct.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then I'll sing on the stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Inhales*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I think she sounds as good as she always does.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Nene's falsetto and vibratos were terrific. She didn't miss a note anywhere either...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's exactly as I thought...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Nene.
That will be enough.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What am I missing?
What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your problem is that you're holding back your emotions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. She's the exact opposite of extroverts, such as the Phoenix Stage singer or you two.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, you may not realize it, but you're being too careful with how you express yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is not to say that being in control is not important, but putting your genuine emotions into a performance is at the top of that list.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should allow your feelings to flow into the song, so that your audience will feel them too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In this case, your serious and focused approach is preventing you from doing that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your technique is perfect. I believe this is the only factor which gives your rival the edge.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So... You're saying Nene just needs to relax more?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To put it simply, yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's not simple at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know how to be more emotional when I sing. How can I do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well... There must be a reason you're holding back.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't remember my next line!
What should I do? What should I do!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... I thought I got over that a long time ago...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe you haven't quite...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
How did you sing before what happened?
That might give you a clue as to what to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know if that's going to help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we're done for the day!
Time to go home!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What are we to do...?
If Nene is in this much of a slump...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene will find her way...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's capable of pinpointing what's nagging at her deep down and confronting it on her own.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... I just can't help worrying about her... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Whoa! My phone lit up!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello, everyone! Miku here♪ How is everyone doing?>

rows.Line: Sigh... That was ten times harder than usual.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Kusanagi, I want a word with you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, uh...
Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Your play was very good...
And your singing was outstanding.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, y-you think so? Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Your last song in particular was... It was so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Are you crying?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: N-No, of course not!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You've proven that you may be worthy of being our rivals. But you'll need to maintain this standard for your next show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe she's not such a bad person after all.
A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Guys! Mr. Mascot brought us an update on the standings!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally! Let me see!
Who's number one...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ph-Phoenix Stage is still number one?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, read it carefully. There's another set of rankings at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The one at the top is for cumulative scores and the one below is just for this last round.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gasp! You're right! And we came out on top for this round! We did it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did it!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naturally, there could have been no other outcome! I knew we wouldn't lose to that fancy Phoenix Stage troupe!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're still behind them in overall score, but victory is within our reach. Everything hinges on the final round of shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I just wanted to say...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you... All of you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I remembered how to sing the way I used to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like I got my own Christmas present a little early...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Funny, but I feel that way too. Don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. I get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your smile, Nene! I've never seen you smile like this before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We all got our present early, so I guess that means today is Christmas for us this year♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! In that case, are you up for a Christmas party in SEKAI? We can tell Miku and her friends the good news too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! You're a genius, Tsukasa!
I'm gonna stuff my face full of cake!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'd like to take a few stage props with us.
Can you help me carry the snow machine?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, you're going to make it snow in SEKAI? Miku and the others are in for a nice surprise.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's go, shall we?
